name: Magna Carta design tokens
description: Resolver for the Magna Carta design-token source: primitive ramps + semantic aliases, modified by theme and mode. Mode files override only semantic aliases (ramp positions), so a future theme is a pure addition: a new theme context overriding ramp values plus, if needed, its own mode overlays.

primitives.description: Primitive scales: color ramps, dimensions, typography, shadows, z-index, motion.

semantic.description: Semantic aliases onto primitives; the only names components consume.

theme.description: Visual theme. slate is the provisional default; new themes add a context here.

mode.description: Light or dark color mode; overrides color-bearing semantic aliases.
